description: This file defines a React component for a Todo application, including the main app component, event handlers, and rendering logic. It manages todo items, routing, and UI updates.

classes.name: TodoApp
classes.description: Main React component managing the Todo list, routing, and user interactions.

methods.name: componentDidMount
methods.description: Sets up routing for different views (all, active, completed) when component mounts.

methods.name: handleNewTodoKeyDown
methods.description: Handles key down event for creating new todo items when Enter is pressed.

methods.name: toggleAll
methods.description: Toggles all todos as completed or active based on checkbox.

methods.name: toggle
methods.description: Toggles the completion state of a specific todo.

methods.name: edit
methods.description: Sets a todo item into editing mode.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves changes to a todo item and exits editing mode.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the Todo app UI based on current state and todos.
